Container.Name: OpenFault
Container.Overview: Self-hosted, Sentry-compatible error tracker. One container, SQLite inside, under 100 MB RAM. Keep your Sentry SDK, change the DSN. Includes an MCP server for coding agents.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web UI, API and Sentry ingest.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database and generated secret. Must be owned by uid 65532 (chown 65532:65532 on first run).

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Public URL (https://errors.example.com) used in DSNs and emails. Leave empty to use the Host header.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 only behind your own reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Setup token
Config.Description: Optional pre-set one-time setup token. Otherwise read it from the container log.
